spec_contract.notes: The four tickets address distinct hardening risks: sensor causality, control safety, inference handoff, and regression scoring.

implementation_plan.notes: Plans include file maps, signature deltas, typed flows, verification, and dependency ordering. TASK-164 should remain a gate, not a runtime feature bucket.

evidence_quality.notes: Evidence requirements are concrete and resistant to overclaiming. Live Kasm evidence remains intentionally outside this local hardening batch.

findings.title: Do not let TASK-164 duplicate TASK-157 scoring
findings.detail: TASK-164 should compose subscores and enforce promotion readiness. The core closed-loop taxonomy and recurrence validation remain owned by TASK-157.

findings.title: Make sensor frame provenance mandatory before live promotion
findings.detail: TASK-161 must feed frame ids into the closed-loop trace; otherwise TASK-160 can still look causal without proving camera freshness.

findings.title: Prefer conservative safety interventions
findings.detail: TASK-162 should optimize for visibly safe stop/slow behavior under OOD conditions before trying impressive evasive maneuvers.
